method: single-listener blind per-case A/B preference; not MOS

conditions.candidate: russtress 0.1.4 dense candidates filtered to selected IDs by Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite

cases.evidence: Control and candidate TTS text were equal and generated WAV SHA-256 values matched.

decision: Reject the simple delete-only russtress-to-Gemini cascade for production. Gemini successfully removed dense ordinary-word marks, but inherited incorrect single stress candidates from russtress. Keep the accepted sparse project lexicon baseline. The next valid experiment should enumerate all allowed homograph variants from a deterministic lexicon and ask the language model to select a candidate ID from context.
